# mistershell_builtin_sensor_source (Resource)

Binds configuration of an existing backend-owned object. Create captures originals and applies only configured fields; destroy restores those originals and never deletes the object. Removing a field restores and releases it. Import explicitly adopts current readable configuration. One binding per object/configuration surface. configuration fields: enabled, parameters (sensitive string object). Built-in sources only. Parameters cannot be introduced or cleared because the API cannot remove them. Changing existing parameters requires restore_parameters with the original plaintext values. Enabling a source that would disable an enabled replacement is rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_builtin_sensor_source" "feed" {
  name = "et/open"
}

resource "mistershell_builtin_sensor_source" "feed" {
  id            = data.mistershell_builtin_sensor_source.feed.id
  configuration = { enabled = true }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) configuration fields: enabled, parameters (sensitive string object). Built-in sources only. Parameters cannot be introduced or cleared because the API cannot remove them. Changing existing parameters requires restore_parameters with the original plaintext values. Enabling a source that would disable an enabled replacement is rejected.
- `id` (String) Existing object ID, stable catalog key, or local. This binding never creates the backend object.

### Optional

- `restore_parameters` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Original plaintext for previously configured masked parameters. Required before managing a parameter; never sent as a mask. Captured originals remain fixed for this binding's lifetime.

### Read-Only

- `original_configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Original owned configuration retained in state for restoration. Do not edit; protect Terraform state.
